title: Deaths by horse kick in the Prussian army
unit: deaths in one corps in one year
source: L. von Bortkiewicz, Das Gesetz der kleinen Zahlen, B. G. Teubner, Leipzig, 1898. The 200 corps-years of 10 corps, 1875 to 1894, in the aggregation that later texts use.

title: Alpha particles in intervals of 7.5 s
unit: particles in one interval of 7.5 s
source: E. Rutherford and H. Geiger, The probability variations in the distribution of α particles, Philosophical Magazine, series 6, 20 (1910) 698–707.

title: Weldon's dice: 12 dice thrown 26,306 times
unit: dice that show 5 or 6 in one throw of 12 dice
source: K. Pearson, On the criterion that a given system of deviations from the probable … has arisen from random sampling, Philosophical Magazine, series 5, 50 (1900) 157–175. The throws are by W. F. R. Weldon.
